title: fix(observability): ConsoleLogger and JsonLogger record an error's cause chain
body:
Fixes #37658

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化：运维用可观测性包的控制台或 JSON 日志器记录错误时，日志里多出被包装的原始错误（每层的消息与堆栈），之前只有最外层；其他用户无感。
- 为什么做：服务器故障日志专题的后续，让这两个日志器与故障日志、内核日志器打出同一种原始错误链。
- 出错会怎样：只影响日志内容，不影响任何请求与数据；可直接撤回。
- 要你做的：无。

## What changes

- `packages/observability/src/loggers.ts`: `ConsoleLogger` and `JsonLogger` `error()` / `fatal()` now add `causes` beside `error` and `stack` when the error carries a `cause` chain: one entry per link, outermost first, each the link's message and stack; at most five links, a cycle stopped at its first repeat, and a marker entry whenever the chain was cut. An error with no `cause` logs byte-identically to before (`causes` omitted).
- The helper is a private copy of `faultCauseChain` (`@objectstack/types`), because `@objectstack/observability` depends on `@objectstack/spec` alone. No runtime dependency added; no export added.
- `packages/observability/package.json`: devDependency on `@objectstack/types` (workspace), for the parity test only; `vitest.config.ts` aliases it to source (`check:test-source-alias`), with the preset's console-intercept setting spelled in place (the plugin-email precedent).
- `packages/core/src/logger-error-cause.test.ts` (N4 of the contract record on PR #37652): the parity block gains one fixture that glues each of the 31 glued redact qualifiers to a default word, plus a control proving the fixture exercises each qualifier, so a list edit in either copy fails the parity test. `ObjectLogger` and `logServerFault` are unchanged.

## Tests

<details><summary>observability: test + typecheck (head d2a09be453)</summary>

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/observability test` then `typecheck`, under the verify lock: `Test Files  7 passed (7)` · `Tests  120 passed (120)` · both `tsc` programs clean · `VERDICT command-exit 0`. `loggers.test.ts` alone: `Tests  44 passed (44)` — per logger: each cause's message and stack, the no-cause control, a cycle, a deep chain cut at the limit; `fatal` for both; 12 parity fixtures per logger against `faultCauseChain`.
</details>

<details><summary>core: test + typecheck (head d2a09be453)</summary>

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/core test` then `typecheck`: `Test Files  158 passed (158)` · `Tests  3791 passed (3791)` · `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation — the cause reading in errorFields (one, as ordered)</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --file packages/observability/src/loggers.ts --anchor "    const causes = causeChain(error);" --replacement "    const causes: CauseLine[] = []; // ABLATION"` around the loggers test file. Landed: anchor 1 to 0, blob d037c912f881 to 3aed5820db82. Result: `Tests  30 failed | 14 passed (44)` — every cause, cycle, depth, fatal and non-empty parity case red; the 14 green are the pre-existing cases, the two no-cause controls, the fixture control and the throwing-getter parity case (an empty chain both ways). Restored: blob equals HEAD (d037c912f881), `git diff HEAD` empty. The test imports `../loggers.js` from source, so no build or dist leg applies.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The two `GLUED_QUALIFIERS` fixture lists are hand copies of the list: a qualifier REMOVED from any copy fails a parity test; one ADDED to a single copy fails nothing until the fixture list grows too.
- `@objectstack/observability` now carries the third copy of the cause-chain helper (types, core, observability), each pinned to `faultCauseChain` by a parity test.

## Verification

Read first: `packages/observability/src/loggers.ts` (`errorFields`, `causeChain` — the only behaviour change), `packages/observability/src/__tests__/loggers.test.ts` (parity block), `packages/observability/vitest.config.ts`.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/observability exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/__tests__/loggers.test.ts` prints `Tests  44 passed (44)`.
